budget_items.topic: FY2024 levy limit and maximum allowable levy
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board presented the FY2024 levy-limit build-up and the maximum allowable levy; as printed, the FY2023 base does not foot to the FY2024 limit.
The amended motion set the single tax rate at $14.10.
budget_items.quote: the motion was amended to include the $14.10 as the single tax rate

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town may exempt up to 10% of valuation for owner-occupied businesses with 10 or fewer employees and valuation under a million; the minutes did not adopt this.
budget_items.quote: exempt up to 10% of the property valuation for owner occupied businesses with 10 or less employees and valuation of less than a million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The 41C recommendation was described as costing about $2,500 to the town, about 57 cents per residence, and Brian Laffond suggested absorbing it from the current overlay.
budget_items.quote: their recommendation has an implication of costing about $2,500 to the town.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Select Board was given four annual cost figures: doing nothing at $5,000 a year, an additional $250 at $10,000 a year, lowering eligibility to age 65 at $7,500 a year, and a combined option. Lou Franco said he would have supported an additional $10,000.
budget_items.quote: your option to do nothing is $5,000 a year, which is the current option.
